note: Hand-curated entries with source URLs. NOT live web research. verified=true means the figure was read in the cited page by the catalog author on checked_on; it does not make the source primary or the number a design fact.

vehicle_mass_target.label: Vehicle weight target (2nd-gen Tesla Roadster, Top Gear walkaround as cited by Wikipedia)
vehicle_mass_target.note: A target 'under 1,700 kg', not a measured production mass. The model default mass is a simplification and differs from this.

wheelbase.label: Wheelbase
wheelbase.note: Stated as 2,825 mm in the cited page.

thruster_count_rocket_variant.label: Cold-gas nozzles on the 'Rocket' variant
thruster_count_rocket_variant.note: Four rear nozzles (Thrust variant) plus six more at front and sides.

tank_volume_thrust_variant.label: Nitrogen COPV volume (Thrust variant)
tank_volume_thrust_variant.note: Rocket variant total 600 L per the same page.

single_use_burn_time.label: Stated duration of one full tank (Thrust variant)
single_use_burn_time.note: 'about five seconds' for a 0-60 mph run; says nothing about per-nozzle thrust.

isp_cold_gas_n2.label: Specific impulse of cold-gas nitrogen
isp_cold_gas_n2.note: Range from docs/judgment-spec.md R4 (marked unverified there). The cited page defines Isp for cold gas but the N2 figure was not confirmed by the catalog author.

nozzle_thrust_per_unit.label: Per-nozzle thrust of the Tesla/SpaceX system
nozzle_thrust_per_unit.note: No official figure known. The sweep over thruster_force_max exists because of this gap.

reference_cold_gas_nozzle_thrust.label: Reference scale: NASA MMU cold-gas nozzle
reference_cold_gas_nozzle_thrust.note: 24 N2 nozzles at 1.4 lbf each; shows how far a car-scale nozzle is from flown cold-gas hardware. Reference only, not used in the model.

model_vehicle_mass.label: Model default vehicle mass
model_vehicle_mass.note: Model default carried over from the roadster spike (spikes/roadster/REPORT.md); not sourced.
